question: Should this stacked Claw state diagnostic land as an explicit doctor lint check once lint reads are non-mutating, or should it wait until the broader Claw state/RFC stack settles?
rationale: The patch is part of a protected, draft Claws stack and checks persisted Claw state that is still being introduced by open prerequisite PRs, so final landing order and product scope need maintainer intent even after the mechanical lint bug is fixed.

options.title: Land After Non-Mutating Lint Fix
options.body: Keep the core doctor diagnostic, but require a read-only state inspection path and focused tests before merging it with the Claws stack.

options.title: Pause Until Stack Settles
options.body: Leave this PR open until the prerequisite Claw artifact and MCP PRs finish review, then rebase and reassess the diagnostic against the settled state contract.

options.title: Move Out Of Core Doctor
options.body: If maintainers decide Claw lifecycle remains experimental or external, close or replace this with a narrower ClawHub/plugin-owned diagnostic path.

recommendation.title: Land After Non-Mutating Lint Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the core doctor diagnostic, but require a read-only state inspection path and focused tests before merging it with the Claws stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across both the doctor lint contract and the Claws stack this PR extends.
